weekly.name: Industry Night
weekly.who: Service workers, bartenders, dancers, staff from other spots
weekly.format: 7pm-3am. Drink specials, no cover with paystub or staff ID.
weekly.drinks: The Shift Change (whiskey + cola), The Last Call (tequila sunrise), Bartender's Breakfast (Irish coffee), Well Drink Specials (50% off all well drinks), Beer + Shot Combo ($8), Jamison Special

weekly.name: No Limit Mondays
weekly.who: Gentlemen who don't have to worry about being to work early on Tuesday — business owners, executives, self-employed
weekly.format: Poker runs 7pm–10pm as the icebreaker/early crowd draw. Swinger atmosphere takes over after 10pm.
weekly.drinks: The Royal Flush (layered red/purple/black cocktail), Pocket Aces (double shot special), The Swing (champagne + bourbon), Red Room (red velvet martini), Safe Word (sweet + spicy margarita), The Mingle (shared punch bowl for 2+)
weekly.costuming: 50 Shades of Grey aesthetic — think sleek, dominant, and sensual. Greys, blacks, leather, silk, restraint-inspired accessories.

weekly.name: Lingerie Lounge
weekly.who: Open crowd, no specific demographic target
weekly.format: Lingerie night with a sophisticated, upscale vibe. Think Victoria's Secret runway meets speakeasy. Cross-promotion with Hustler Adult Stores and local apparel companies.
weekly.drinks: The Teddy (white chocolate + raspberry martini), Silk Sheets (vanilla vodka + cream), Lace & Leather (smoky mezcal + honey), Champagne Room (bottle service special), The Runway (glitter champagne cocktail), Black Lace (blackberry + gin + activated charcoal)
weekly.costuming: Entertainers in teddys, lingerie, and bedroom wear

weekly.name: Level Up
weekly.who: Semi-upscale college crowd — 21-28, elevated energy without going full club
weekly.format: High-energy, exciting atmosphere. The 'in-crowd.' Essentially the gentleman's club version of a college night.
weekly.drinks: The Keg Stand (beer tower special), Jungle Juice (fruit punch + vodka), Body Shots (tequila + lime + salt), The Funnel (shared cocktail pitcher), Beach Bum (malibu + pineapple), Red Solo Cup (mixed drink in a giant cup), The Dorm Room (cheap beer bucket special)
weekly.games: Spring Break Type Games. MAIN EVENT: Video Games on LED Screen — Mario Kart vs Entertainer. Sign-up sheet with time slots (customer vs dancer). 2-3 min races. Customer wins = 1 free lapdance. Entertainer wins = customer buys 2 lapdances at normal price.

weekly.name: Chicks 'n' Kicks
weekly.who: Sneakerhead culture — people who love a high energy, exciting atmosphere who have disposable income. The 'in-crowd.'
weekly.format: Throwbacks in all genres pre-2010. Sneaker culture night. Cross-promotion with local high-end sneaker stores.
weekly.drinks: Sneakertini, My Adidas, The Air Force One, etc
weekly.costuming: The whole point — entertainers wear dope sneakers with coordinating outfits. Fresh kicks front and center with fits that match the energy.

weekly.name: Femme Fatale Fridays
weekly.who: Guests who appreciate sophistication — people who come for the experience of seeing entertainers dressed and performing as polished, sexy, elegant women.
weekly.format: High-end, glamorous night out. Showtime Showcase every Friday and Saturday at midnight. Featured Entertainer of the weekend takes the stage both nights for a carefully curated, high-production performance.
weekly.drinks: The Femme Fatale (dark rum + blackberry + gold leaf), Diamonds Are Forever (champagne + vodka + edible glitter), The Secret Agent (gin + cucumber + elderflower), Red Lipstick (red wine + bourbon + cherry), Silk & Dagger (sake + lychee + rose), The Executive (scotch + smoked orange peel + bitters)
weekly.games: Showtime Showcase at midnight — entertainers introduced one by one, each takes a spin around the stage. Immediately following: dance special 2 for $40.

weekly.name: AFTER DARK presented by Torch Radio
weekly.who: The after-hours crowd — people who want to keep the party going when everything else closes
weekly.format: After hours — we go until the early hours of the morning. Underground vibe. Guest DJs regularly. The only spot to BE after 2am in Boise on Saturdays — full kitchen serving breakfast items. Higher cover charge after 2am.
weekly.drinks: Breakfast Specials — push food sales hard. Full kitchen open after 2am: breakfast items, late-night bites. Food revenue is a key profit driver for this night.
weekly.games: Showtime Showcase at midnight. Featured Entertainer performs a carefully curated, high-production set. After 2am — Late Night kicks in: guest DJs, full kitchen with Breakfast Specials.

yearly.name: Animal House Halloween
yearly.format: Carnival/Freak Show with drummers, aerialists, poi/LED performers, singers, choreographed dancers, freak show performances (light hearted), etc. Special performances.
yearly.drinks: Bottle Specials on High End Liquors, Circus and Drummer inspired drinks, Animal themed drink special
yearly.costuming: Circus/Freak Show type costuming for show performers

yearly.name: Tailgate & Touchdown
yearly.who: Sports fans, local crowd, football-season regulars — all demographics, 21+
yearly.format: Daytime parking lot party kicking off football season. Beer tubs, food trucks, lawn games. Party moves inside after dark for the late-night set.
yearly.games: Cornhole, beer pong, giant Jenga, fantasy football draft board, jersey raffle
yearly.costuming: Jerseys, team gear encouraged — entertainers in team colors or cheerleader-style outfits

yearly.name: New Year's Eve Gala
yearly.who: Couples, groups, anyone looking for a premium NYE experience
yearly.format: Premium open bar packages, champagne toast at midnight, countdown celebration, special NYE menu. Higher cover, VIP tables available.
yearly.drinks: Champagne packages, Midnight Kiss (champagne + strawberry), Resolution cocktails
yearly.games: Countdown celebration, midnight kiss contest, resolution wall, photo booth
yearly.costuming: Formal/cocktail attire encouraged. Black tie optional VIP section.

yearly.name: Valentine's Special
yearly.who: Couples, singles, anyone looking for a romantic or anti-Valentine's night out
yearly.format: Couples packages, singles mingle games, romantic decor, red and pink theme. Special couples dances and VIP experiences.
yearly.drinks: Love Potion (pink cocktail), Broken Heart (whiskey + bitters), Cupid's Arrow (champagne + raspberry)
yearly.games: Singles mingle speed dating, couples dance contest, love song request hour
yearly.costuming: Red, pink, or black attire. Romantic or anti-romantic theme encouraged.

yearly.name: St. Patrick's Day Bash
yearly.who: Everyone — green beer and Irish whiskey draws all crowds
yearly.format: Full green decor, Irish whiskey specials, green beer, shamrock everything. DJ plays Irish rock remixes and party hits.
yearly.drinks: Green Beer, Irish Car Bombs, Jameson specials, Shamrock Shots
yearly.games: Best green outfit contest, Irish trivia, pot of gold raffle
yearly.costuming: Green mandatory. Leprechaun hats, shamrock accessories encouraged.

yearly.name: Blacklight Party
yearly.who: Everyone — high-energy crowd who loves neon, UV glow, and visual spectacle
yearly.format: Full club UV/blacklight transformation. Neon body paint station, glow sticks, white clothing encouraged. DJ plays high-energy EDM and hip-hop.
yearly.drinks: Glow-in-the-dark cocktails (tonic water base), Neon Margaritas, Blacklight Beer specials
yearly.games: Best glow outfit contest, neon body paint competition, glow stick dance-off
yearly.costuming: White or neon clothing required for full effect. Body paint available at entry.

yearly.name: Pole Competition
yearly.who: Entertainers, pole fitness community, fans of athletic performance art
yearly.format: Multi-round pole dancing competition with judges panel. Amateur and pro divisions. Audience voting + professional scoring.
yearly.drinks: Champagne specials, VIP bottle service for judges/sponsors, themed cocktails per round
yearly.games: Competition rounds (technical, artistic, freestyle), audience vote, judges' choice awards
yearly.costuming: Competition-appropriate athletic wear. Judges in formal attire.

promoIdeas.name: Torch Radio w/ANIMAL
promoIdeas.concept: Monthly podcast showcasing the music we play in the club, interviews with entertainers, guests, and music artists.
promoIdeas.format: ~1 hour episodes. Behind-the-scenes interviews, industry talk, entertainment culture, track highlights from Saturday nights.

promoIdeas.name: Influencer & Street Team Program
promoIdeas.concept: Unified outreach program targeting social media influencers, nightlife insiders (bouncers and bartenders), and grassroots street team activators.
promoIdeas.format: Three tiers: Tier 1 (Social Influencers), Tier 2 (Nightlife Insiders), Tier 3 (Street Team). Relationship-first, never require a post.
promoIdeas.distribution: Direct DMs for influencer outreach, in-person visits to neighboring bars, flyers and QR codes for street team.

promoIdeas.name: Content Creation & Social Media
promoIdeas.concept: Behind-the-scenes, crowd moments, DJ highlights, influencer collabs. Daily stories + 3–5 posts/week on Instagram, 2–3 videos/week on TikTok.
promoIdeas.format: Content pillars: Behind the Scenes, Guest Moments, DJ Sets, Influencer Collabs, Podcast Clips
